g.text: Where the covariance-aware fit gains over lsei on the same bulks
Fill: log2 of the mean RMSE of p1-hat over the lsei RMSE, same bulks; blue: lower than lsei.
Grey contours: Gaussian overlap of the component laws N(mu_j, R_j) (MixSim, 5 levels), the same for both laws; it does not measure |rho_1 - rho_2|.
